title: Cats and More Cats variation
author: Melanie Axel-Lute
problems: Row 4 "balance & Rory O'More right · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
Row 5 "balance & Rory O'More left · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
Row 5 "balance & Rory O'More left · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
Row 4 "balance & Rory O'More right · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers are not in a straight line.
Row 5 "balance & Rory O'More left · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers are not in a straight line.
Row 5 "balance & Rory O'More left · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers are not in a straight line.
choices: Rory O'More spins one full turn in the travel direction (the usual styling).
The balance before each Rory steps toward the slide direction first.
Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A pass through from a ring goes along the set, to the dancer on your own side.
A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
